_README: MultiTurn run: the 8 detectors of the 2026-09 roster plus kimi-k2.6 and
gemini-3-flash, the two paper models that also have MultiStep and MultiImage
data -- they are the only ones that can complete the
gemini-3-flash is inherited from detect.py's built-ins unchanged.
DashScope keys: one slow model each -- KEY_1 qwen3.8-max-0902, KEY_2 kimi-k3,
Each DashScope key is bound to its OWN workspace host, so key_env and endpoint must move together -- rekeying alone yields 'Workspace endpoint access denied'.

detectors.name: qwen3.8-max-0902
detectors.notes: doc: Qwen3.8 hybrid, thinking mode enabled by default; measured reasoning_content returned

detectors.name: qwen3.8-flash
detectors.notes: doc: Qwen3.8 hybrid, thinking mode enabled by default; measured reasoning_content returned

detectors.name: kimi-k3
detectors.notes: doc page documents the maximum chain-of-thought length but not the default; measured reasoning_content returned by default -> thinking on

detectors.name: deepseek-v4.1-flash
detectors.notes: doc: DeepSeek v4 family default enabled (v4-pro/v4-flash listed); measured reasoning_content returned

detectors.name: gpt-5.6-terra
detectors.notes: doc: GPT-5.6 defaults to reasoning_effort 'medium'. Measured 47 reasoning tokens -> not set

detectors.name: gemini-3.8-flash
detectors.notes: doc: thinking default 'On (medium)', cannot be disabled. Measured 315 thought tokens -> not set

detectors.name: grok-4.6
detectors.notes: doc lists no reasoning toggle; empirically reasoning_effort='low' is accepted but 'none' returns HTTP 400, so reasoning is always on. Measured 1192 reasoning tokens at default -> not set

detectors.name: gpt-6-astra
detectors.notes: doc: reasoning_effort default is model-dependent; GPT-6 Astra rejects 'none' (HTTP 400) so reasoning cannot be turned off. Measured 36 reasoning tokens at default -> not set

detectors.name: kimi-k2.6
detectors.notes: paper roster; moved to KEY_1 so each key carries one slow model
